source.title: Assist, pass leads directly to made field goal - pass and jump shot
source.period: NBA assist definition; page update date unknown
source.excerpt: An assist is credited to the player tossing the last pass leading directly to a made field goal, but only if the player scoring the goal demonstrates an immediate reaction toward the basket after receiving the pass.
